chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from one of his men, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
A dirham by which the Imam is supported is superior to two thousand thousand dirhams spent in other aspects of righteousness.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more excellent and superior in merit
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam, the divinely appointed leader
key_terms.دِرْهَمٌ: a unit of money; a single coin of monetary spending
key_terms.وُجُوهِ الْبِرِّ: the various avenues and forms of righteousness
key_terms.يُوصَلُ: is delivered or conveyed in support

ai.seo_question: Why is spending in support of the Imam superior to other charitable spending?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that supporting the Imam carries a unique excellence surpassing even vast sums spent in other charitable causes. It highlights the special religious value of aiding the divinely designated authority.
